Third-party libraries bundled with SeatVault, served from /vendor so the
Content-Security-Policy can stay same-origin. Each file was checked against
its publisher's integrity hash before being added.

sockjs-1.6.1.min.js  sockjs-client 1.6.1   MIT          https://github.com/sockjs/sockjs-client
                     verified against the cdnjs SRI hash
stomp-2.3.3.min.js   stomp-websocket 2.3.3 Apache-2.0   https://github.com/jmesnil/stomp-websocket
                     verified against the cdnjs SRI hash
jsqr-1.4.0.js        jsQR 1.4.0            Apache-2.0   https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
                     dist/jsQR.js from the npm tarball, whose sha512 matched the
                     registry's dist.integrity:
